description: Fix the schools_rank family regression and generalize it to honour each reference's true page SIZE and page COUNT. src/sars/templates/schools_rank.py was rebuilt as a fixed-layout single-Letter-page renderer for the council report MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK (0 logical mismatches, correct 792x612 page, ~75.9% visible). But that same renderer is registered for the region multi-page variants (Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments 4p, 'Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments (1)' 4p, Mwanza schools rank Overall 6p) and for top_schools (MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS 3p, Mwanza Top 10 Schools 6p) and currently forces those multi-page reports onto ONE wrong-sized page, causing pixel_diff DIMENSION MISMATCH. Generalize the fixed-layout approach so each of these reports emits its reference's own Letter page box AND its reference page count with correct pagination, OR split into per-variant renderers if that is cleaner. Follow the project learning: per-report/per-family independence over shared abstraction is acceptable; do NOT regress the council schools_rank result.
steps: Read the reference geometry for each affected report via extract_document(pair.pdf, pair.html): pages count, each page width/height, per-table col_edges/row_edges, per-cell rowspan/colspan and Style (family/size_pt/bold/color/background/align/rotation). Use these exact recovered values; do not guess.

Preserve the working council path: MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK must keep its current single 792x612 page and 0 cell mismatches. Verify with cell_diff BEFORE and AFTER any change so you can prove no regression.
Set @page to the reference's OWN page box (792pt 612pt landscape here) instead of A4, matching the schools_rank.py pattern (@page{size:792pt 612pt;margin:0}).

Emit the correct number of pages: for a report whose reference has N pages, produce N pages that break where the reference breaks (paginate the data rows across pages so the row count per page matches the reference row split as closely as the recovered geometry allows). Use CSS page breaks / one positioned .report section per page.

Handle the top_schools variants (MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS, Mwanza Top 10 Schools) which reuse render_schools_rank via RENDERERS['top_schools']. If their structure differs enough from schools_rank, give top_schools its OWN fixed-layout renderer and register it in src/sars/templates/__init__.py; otherwise generalize schools_rank to cover both. Match each report's true page size and page count.
Handle the region multi-page schools_rank variants (Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments, its (1) byte-identical duplicate, Mwanza schools rank Overall) at their true page size and page count.
Keep fonts real (Arial/Times New Roman), per-cell fill washes keyed to recovered fills, rotated rank captions, and recovered per-row heights as in schools_rank.py.
Regenerate: `uv run sars data` then `uv run sars template` (targeting these reports).
Measure each report with cell_diff (aim 0 logical mismatches) and pixel_diff (must NOT DIMENSION MISMATCH; record honest visible%).
acceptance_criteria: MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK still renders as a single 792x612 page with 0 logical cell mismatches (no regression).

Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments, 'Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments (1)', and Mwanza schools rank Overall each render at 792x612 with page count equal to their reference (4, 4, 6 respectively) and pixel_diff runs without DIMENSION MISMATCH.
MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS (3 pages) and Mwanza Top 10 Schools (6 pages) render at their reference page size and page count and pixel_diff runs without DIMENSION MISMATCH.
For every report in this family cell_diff logical mismatch count is recorded (aim 0) and pixel_diff visible% is recorded honestly.
verification: uv run python tools/cell_diff.py "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" --template -v
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments" --template
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "Mwanza schools rank Overall" --template
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS" --template
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "Mwanza Top 10 Schools" --template
